text:
Anna (Docs): quick heads-up — opening a small PR to refresh the Hello Mini quickstart with a containerized auth example and a tiny CLI hint. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
Michael (DevEx): :eyes: thanks. can you highlight the parts that changed vs current? i can do a quick pass for snippet style
Anna (Docs): main changes: switch from `apiKey` env var naming to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, add docker-compose section, add minimal `redwoodctl init` call and a one-line smoke curl test. also update sdk snip to SDK v10 constructor
James (Eng): heads-up — CI lint will fail on the new python snippet if we don't pin `requests` in the example. also we should avoid showing raw api key in examples
Sarah (Product): can we keep the Quickstart under 4 steps? users say the previous one felt long. maybe put the compose part in an "optional" box
Anna (Docs): good idea. i'll make compose optional and move the extended flow to an "advanced" note
James (Eng): small nit: the python snippet uses `RedwoodClient(api_key=...)` but SDK v10 does `RedwoodClient.from_env()` — suggest we show both and prefer from_env
Anna (Docs): ok i'll show the minimal `from_env()` path and an appendix with explicit constructor
Michael (DevEx): i'll add a tiny test job to CI that does:
```
# run quickstart smoke test
docker compose -f docker/hello-minima.yml up --build -d
sleep 2
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1
```
James (Eng): deploy-bot reports: build 4821 failed on lint in docs PRs
deploy-bot: CI failed — docs/lint — see https://ci.internal/4821
Anna (Docs): i'll fix lint issues in the PR, probably trailing whitespace and a rogue backtick
Michael (DevEx): once lint is green i can run the smoke test job and approve
Anna (Docs): pushed a small commit to address the lint + replaced `apiKey` with `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. PTAL
Sarah (Product): :thumbsup: love the optional advanced section
James (Eng): :shipit: from eng if CI passes
deploy-bot: CI passed — docs/lint & docs/smoke — build 4823
Anna (Docs): merging after another quick glance from @Michael (DevEx) — thanks everyone!
Michael (DevEx): done, merged. will follow up with a short tweet and updates to quickstart checklist
Anna (Docs): recording note to track redirect for old link /quickstart -> /getting-started/hello-mini (follow-up task in the docs board)
